annotations.title: Speaker labels: transcribe audio with who said what (diarization)

description: Transcribe a meeting, interview, call or podcast with speaker labels: each turn says which speaker talked, with start and end times (Deepgram Nova-3). MP3/WAV up to 15 minutes, other formats up to 2 MB, by URL or upload. Optional redaction of personal data (pii), card numbers (pci) or numbers, and subtitles with the speaker in each line. Use for meeting minutes, interview transcripts, call reviews and podcast show notes. Example: url=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/77/Tofino_pronunciation.mp3. Price $0.10/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

language.description: Spoken language code such as en, es, de or fr (default: detected)

redact.description: pii (names, addresses, phone numbers and other personal data), pci (card numbers) or numbers: replaced in the transcript

subtitles.description: srt or vtt: also return subtitles, each line starting with its speaker

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the recording (MP3/WAV up to 15 minutes; M4A, OGG, WebM or FLAC up to 2 MB); or POST the file itself (raw body, multipart `file` part, or base64 in JSON)
